# device-gateway API

Mower links of the installation (operator view).

Base path `/api/v1/device-gateway` behind the gateway. Authentication, rate limits and the error format are the same for every service: see [Scripting MowDeck](../../guides/scripting.md). Rendered from [`apps/web/openapi/device-gateway.json`](https://github.com/lukislp/mowdeck/blob/main/apps/web/openapi/device-gateway.json) (OpenAPI 3.1), which you can also load into any OpenAPI tool.

## Operations

### device-gateway

#### GET /api/v1/device-gateway/mowers

**List Mowers**

Mowers held by this instance with connection status and last activity.

Principals bound to an account see only that account's mowers; operators and services (no account) see all mowers of the shard.

| Status | Meaning | Body |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 200 | Successful Response | `application/json` [HeldMowers](#heldmowers) |

## Schemas

### ConnectionKind

How the Device-Gateway is connected to the mower.

Type: `"ble_bridge"` \| `"wifi"` \| `"cloud"` \| `"simulated"`

### ConnectionStatus

Link state of one mower held by the gateway.

Type: `"connecting"` \| `"connected"` \| `"reconnecting"` \| `"closed"`

### HeldMower

A mower held by this Device-Gateway instance.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `account_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `activity` | [MowerActivity](#moweractivity) or null | yes |  |
| `battery_percent` | integer or null | yes |  |
| `commands_in_flight` | integer | yes |  |
| `connected_since` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `connection_kind` | [ConnectionKind](#connectionkind) | yes |  |
| `last_activity_at` | string (date-time) or null | yes |  |
| `mower_id` | string (uuid) | yes |  |
| `name` | string | yes |  |
| `status` | [ConnectionStatus](#connectionstatus) | yes |  |

### HeldMowers

The mowers of this instance's shard.

| Field | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `mowers` | array of [HeldMower](#heldmower) | yes |  |
| `shard_count` | integer | yes |  |
| `shard_index` | integer | yes |  |

### MowerActivity

What the mower is doing right now.

Type: `"idle"` \| `"mowing"` \| `"paused"` \| `"returning"` \| `"docked"` \| `"charging"` \| `"error"` \| `"offline"` \| `"updating"` \| `"unknown"`
